'''Howard "Trey" Samuel Thompkins III''' (born May 20, 1990)<ref>http://www.georgiadogs.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/thompkins_trey00.html</ref> is an [[United States|American]] [[college basketball]] player. He is a {{convert|6|ft|10|in|m|2|abbr=on}} [[power forward]] for the [[University of Georgia]].<ref>http://www.georgiadogs.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/thompkins_trey00.html</ref>

==High school==
Thompkins attended the [[Wesleyan School]] in [[Norcross, Georgia]]. During his junior year, Thompkins decided to attend [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] where he averaged 15.8 points per game and 8.9 rebounds. For his senior season, Thompkins averaged 27.5 points and 14.7 rebounds for the Wolves.<ref>http://www.georgiadogs.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/thompkins_trey00.html</ref> In May 2007, Thompkins committed to the [[University of Georgia]] for the 2008-2009 NCAA season despite offers from many other schools.<ref>http://www.sicemdawgs.com/basketball/2007/trey_thompkins.php</ref>

==College==

In Thompkins freshman season for the Bulldogs, he was named to the SEC All-Freshman team while leading the team in rebounding (7.4) and blocks (31 total) and second in points (12.6).<ref>http://www.sicemdawgs.com/basketball/2007/trey_thompkins.php</ref> He missed the preseason practices and first four regular season games due to injury while the team eventually finished the season below expectations, having head coach [[Dennis Felton]] fired midseason.<ref>
http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/news/story?id=3868747</ref>

In his sophomore season, Thompkins skied to averages of 17.7 points and 8.3 rebounds. He was a unanimous vote for the first team All-Sec selection.<ref>http://www.georgiadogs.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/thompkins_trey00.html</ref>

Thompkins leveled out in his junior year statistically, while the Bulldogs eventually made it to the [[2011 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament]] only to be eliminated 68-65 in the first round to the [[Washington Huskies]].<ref>http://www.sbnation.com/2011-ncaa-tournament/2011/3/14/2050185/ncaa-basketball-tournament-2011-schedule-preview</ref> He was once again an first team All-Sec selection.

==Professional career==
Thompkins announced that he would leave Georgia and forgo his senior season to enter the [[2011 NBA Draft]] on April 5, 2011.<ref>http://aol.sportingnews.com/ncaa-basketball/story/2011-04-05/georgias-thompkins-declares-for-the-nba-draft</ref>

==Personal==

Thompkins' father Howard Thompkins Jr. played basketball collegiately at [[Wagner College]] and then was drafted by the [[Atlanta Hawks]] in 1981.<ref>http://www.georgiadogs.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/thompkins_trey00.html</ref>
